# CLI: LoadBalancer

## delete-certificate

Kind: Write, destructive.

Reads the certificate before deleting it and refuses if a listener uses it.

| Flag               | Type     | Required |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--certificate-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode loadbalancer delete-certificate --certificate-id <certificate-id> --yes
```

## delete-load-balancer

Kind: Write, destructive.

Waits up to 15 minutes for the load balancer to disappear. Use `--no-wait` to
return after acceptance or when a deletion is already in progress.

| Flag                 | Type     | Required |
| -------------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--load-balancer-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--no-wait`          | `bool`   |          |

```sh
greennode loadbalancer delete-load-balancer --load-balancer-id <load-balancer-id> --yes
```

## quote-create-load-balancer

Kind: Read.

Quotes the selected package and zone without ordering. The price is in VND per
month and includes VAT. `--name` and `--type` do not affect the quote. If
provided, `--scheme` and `--subnet-id` are validated.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--name`                                 | `string`  |          |
| `--package-id`                           | `string`  | yes      |
| `--type`                                 | `string`  |          |
| `--scheme`                               | `string`  |          |
| `--subnet-id`                            | `string`  |          |
| `--zone-id`                              | `string`  | yes      |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode loadbalancer quote-create-load-balancer --package-id <package-id> --zone-id <zone-id>
```

## quote-resize-load-balancer

Kind: Read.

Quotes the new package without resizing. Use the load balancer’s `ZoneID` when
listing packages. Prices are in VND and include VAT.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--load-balancer-id`                     | `string`  | yes      |
| `--package-id`                           | `string`  | yes      |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode loadbalancer quote-resize-load-balancer --load-balancer-id <load-balancer-id> --package-id <package-id>
```
